c2-gen-0027: On the fourth day God set lights in the sky. Listen to why they were set there in Genesis 1:14.
c2-gen-0028: The first river from Eden is named. Later Adam gives names to the cattle, the birds, and the beasts. Stay with Genesis 2:11 and Genesis 2:20.
c3-gen-0018: God divided the light from the darkness. Later Adam gave his wife a name. Stay with Genesis 1:4 and Genesis 3:20.
c3-isa-0017: Isaiah speaks of the LORD hearing His people, and of the descendants of those the LORD has blessed. Sit with Isaiah 65:23 and Isaiah 65:24.
c3-gen-0019: The man says the woman gave him of the tree. Earlier, Adam speaks of her with wonder. Stay with Genesis 2:23 and Genesis 3:12.
c3-gen-0020: God placed the lights in the firmament. Then comes the day when the heavens and the earth were finished. Hear it in Genesis 1:17 and Genesis 2:1.
c3-gen-0021: God speaks to the woman of sorrow and conception. Earlier, the verse tells how God made man. Listen in Genesis 1:27 and Genesis 3:16.
c3-gen-0022: The man speaks after he ate of the tree. Earlier, a man is joined to his wife. Stay with Genesis 2:24 and Genesis 3:12.
c3-rev-0006: They shall bring the glory and the honor of the nations into the city. The one who talked with John was ready to measure it. Stay with Revelation 21:15 and Revelation 21:26.
c3-rev-0007: Nothing that defiles shall enter the city. Then the throne of God and of the Lamb is named. Rest with Revelation 21:27 and Revelation 22:3.
c2-mrk-0010: After John was held under guard, Jesus came to Galilee preaching, and He called people to repent. Listen to His words in Mark 1:15.
c2-dan-0009: The king has been given a kingdom, power, strength, and glory. Daniel also speaks of a great image. Stay with Daniel 2:31 and Daniel 2:37.
c3-dan-0007: They will tell the interpretation before the king. The toes were partly of iron and partly of clay. Sit with Daniel 2:36 and Daniel 2:42.
c3-psa-0014: One generation shall praise His works to another. The psalm also calls the LORD great. Stay with Psalm 145:3 and Psalm 145:4.
c3-mat-0012: The disciples asked why He spoke in parables. Great crowds were gathered to Him, and He sat, while the crowd stood on the shore. Stay with Matthew 13:2 and Matthew 13:10.
c3-dan-0008: The psalm says the speaker will lift up the LORD, his God and King. In Daniel, the metals are broken in pieces, and the dream is described. Stay with Daniel 2:45 and Psalm 145:1.
c3-dan-0009: Mark tells of Jesus coming to Galilee after John was taken away. In Daniel, God gives the beasts and birds into the king's hand. Hear these words in Daniel 2:38 and Mark 1:14.
c3-mat-0013: The fourth kingdom will break in pieces and crush all the others. Jesus also tells a story about the kingdom of heaven. Stay with Matthew 13:47 and Daniel 2:40.
c3-psa-0015: Daniel speaks of another kingdom, lesser than the first. The psalm calls His kingdom an everlasting kingdom. Sit with Psalm 145:13 and Daniel 2:39.
c3-mat-0014: The psalm says the speaker's mouth shall speak the praise of the LORD. Jesus spoke all these things to the crowd. Stay with Matthew 13:34 and Psalm 145:21.
c2-ezk-0014: The LORD promises to take His people from among the nations and bring them into their own land. Listen to that promise in Ezekiel 36:24.
c2-jhn-0022: Jesus speaks of righteousness, because He goes to the Father. He also says He still has many things to say to them. Stay with John 16:10 and John 16:12.
c3-jhn-0011: Jesus says He tells them the truth. He speaks of His going away, and of sin. Stay with John 16:7 and John 16:9.
c3-act-0007: This is what was spoken by Joel. Then comes the Day of Pentecost. Stay with Acts 2:1 and Acts 2:16.
c3-rom-0015: Paul speaks of hoping for what we do not see. He also speaks of being saved in this hope. Stay with Romans 8:24 and Romans 8:25.
c3-jhn-0012: The Father will give the Helper. Jesus also says the Helper will glorify Him. Sit with John 14:16 and John 16:14.
c3-act-0008: Peter says God has raised this Jesus, and they are all witnesses. As the people wondered, they asked about those who were speaking. Stay with Acts 2:7 and Acts 2:32.
c3-act-0009: They had favor with all the people. Peter also speaks of God raising Jesus. Stay with Acts 2:24 and Acts 2:47.
c3-rom-0016: The creation was put under empty, hard things. Paul also speaks of those who are in the flesh. Stay with Romans 8:8 and Romans 8:20.
c3-gal-0003: Paul warns the believers not to become proud. He also speaks of these two. Stay with Galatians 5:17 and Galatians 5:26.
c2-deu-0016: The LORD promised to raise up one like Moses from among their brethren. Listen to that promise in Deuteronomy 18:18.
c2-exo-0023: The LORD spoke to Moses and Aaron while they were in Egypt. He also speaks of this month. Stay with Exodus 12:1 and Exodus 12:2.
c3-lev-0005: The verse describes what Aaron shall put on his body. Then he stands before the LORD at the door of the tabernacle of meeting. Stay with Leviticus 16:4 and Leviticus 16:7.
c3-exo-0008: They are told when to keep it. A neighbor may be included, and the animal is counted. Listen in Exodus 12:4 and Exodus 12:6.
c3-heb-0010: The priests always went into the first part of the tabernacle. The first covenant also had rules for holy service. Stay with Hebrews 9:1 and Hebrews 9:6.
c3-lev-0006: That day is called a sabbath of solemn rest. Before the live goat is brought, the priest's work at the holy places is spoken of. Stay with Leviticus 16:20 and Leviticus 16:31.
c3-lev-0007: The priest who is anointed and set apart shall sprinkle some of the blood of the bull on the mercy seat. Stay with Leviticus 16:14 and Leviticus 16:32.
c3-gen-0023: The LORD says He has sworn by Himself. As they reached the place, Abraham stretched out his hand. Stay with Genesis 22:10 and Genesis 22:16.
c3-heb-0011: The high priest went in alone once a year, not without blood. The tabernacle also has a part called the Holiest of All. Stay with Hebrews 9:3 and Hebrews 9:7.
c3-heb-0012: The verse mentions foods and drinks, various washings, and rules for the body. It also speaks of the ark and the mercy seat. Sit with Hebrews 9:5 and Hebrews 9:10.
c2-psa-0024: The psalm describes those who see the speaker and make fun of Him. They even shoot out the lip. Stay with Psalm 22:7.
c2-isa-0025: Isaiah asks who has believed the report. Then he speaks of this One's suffering. Stay with Isaiah 53:1 and Isaiah 53:4.
c3-psa-0016: The speaker asks that God not be far, for trouble is near. The psalm begins with a cry to God. Stay with Psalm 22:1 and Psalm 22:11.
c3-isa-0018: My righteous Servant shall justify many. Isaiah also speaks of this One being cut off. Hear it in Isaiah 53:8 and Isaiah 53:11.
c3-jhn-0013: They filled a sponge with sour wine and put it to His mouth. The soldiers took His garments and made four parts. Stay with John 19:23 and John 19:29.
c3-psa-0017: John shares another Scripture in that hour. The psalm speaks of the wicked enclosing Him. Stay with Psalm 22:16 and John 19:37.
c3-jhn-0014: The LORD has laid on Him the iniquity of us all. The soldiers came to Jesus and saw that He was already dead. Stay with John 19:33 and Isaiah 53:6.
c3-psa-0018: Isaiah speaks again of the Servant making many right with God. In the psalm, the speaker calls himself a reproach of men. Sit with Psalm 22:6 and Isaiah 53:11.
c3-mic-0009: Our fathers trusted in God. Micah then speaks of this One, and of the Assyrian. Stay with Micah 5:5 and Psalm 22:4.
c3-mat-0015: Isaiah wonders who has believed the report. Later, Herod gathered the chief priests and scribes. Stay with Matthew 2:4 and Isaiah 53:1.
c2-isa-0026: Isaiah speaks as the city is in her light, and he says her light has come. Listen to that call in Isaiah 60:1.
c2-isa-0027: Isaiah speaks of the person from another land who has joined himself to the LORD. The LORD promises a gift in His house and within His walls. Stay with Isaiah 56:3 and Isaiah 56:5.
c3-isa-0020: You shall cry, and He will answer. The LORD also describes the fast He has chosen, and the loosing of the bonds of wickedness. Stay with Isaiah 58:6 and Isaiah 58:9.
c3-isa-0021: The LORD calls out to a nation that had not sought Him. Then some people tell others to keep away. Stay with Isaiah 65:1 and Isaiah 65:5.
c3-isa-0022: My servants shall sing for joy of heart. Then the LORD speaks, and He also speaks of the earth. Sit with Isaiah 65:14 and Isaiah 66:1.
c3-isa-0023: The LORD calls His people to keep justice and do what is right. He also says their light shall dawn in the darkness. Stay with Isaiah 56:1 and Isaiah 58:10.
c3-isa-0024: Those who keep His Sabbaths are named. Later, violence is no longer heard in the land. Stay with Isaiah 56:4 and Isaiah 60:18.
c3-isa-0025: You shall delight yourself in the LORD. He will look on him who is poor and whose heart is humbled. Stay with Isaiah 58:14 and Isaiah 66:2.
c3-isa-0026: Isaiah speaks of what remains before the LORD. He also speaks of the gates. Listen in Isaiah 60:11 and Isaiah 66:22.
c3-isa-0027: Before she was in labor, she gave birth. The verse also speaks of Sharon. Stay with Isaiah 65:10 and Isaiah 66:7.
c2-ezk-0015: Ezekiel is taken to the gateway and sees a man standing there. Stay with Ezekiel 40:3.
c2-ezk-0016: He is told to look, hear, and fix his mind on everything shown him. The hand of the LORD came upon him. Stay with Ezekiel 40:1 and Ezekiel 40:4.
c3-ezk-0009: The law of the temple is given. After they may be ashamed of their sins, the pattern is set before them. Stay with Ezekiel 43:10 and Ezekiel 43:12.
c3-ezk-0010: They shall put on linen garments in the inner court. Then he is brought back to the outer gateway of the sanctuary that faces east. Stay with Ezekiel 44:1 and Ezekiel 44:17.
c3-ezk-0011: The north-side measurements of the city are given. They shall also inherit the land. Stay with Ezekiel 47:14 and Ezekiel 48:30.
c3-ezk-0012: He was set on a high mountain. If they are ashamed of all they have done, he is to make the temple known to them. Stay with Ezekiel 40:2 and Ezekiel 43:11.
c3-ezk-0013: He heard Him speaking from the temple. The priests are told about linen turbans and linen trousers. Stay with Ezekiel 43:6 and Ezekiel 44:18.
c3-ezk-0014: A piece of land is set apart, twenty-five thousand cubits wide. The priests shall teach the people the difference between the holy and the unholy. Stay with Ezekiel 44:23 and Ezekiel 48:8.
c3-ezk-0015: They shall divide this land among themselves according to the tribes of Israel. The city's measure all the way around is given. Stay with Ezekiel 47:21 and Ezekiel 48:35.
c3-ezk-0016: He was brought toward the east. Names are given for the north side of the city. Stay with Ezekiel 43:1 and Ezekiel 48:31.
